clusters.hook: 字根 string/strict＝綁／緊——繩索庫專管嚴格、限制、緊繃與約束。
clusters.script: strict／strictly／stricture 繩子勒緊。restrict／restriction／restrictive 限制區。constrain／constraint 約束帶。astringent 澀味收斂；strain／stringent 拉緊／嚴厲——庫管：stringent prereg；restrictive paywalls 要拆。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a strict separation of roles in analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 分析中嚴格分離角色。

members.speakLineEn: Strictly pre-specify primary outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴格預先指定主要結局。

members.speakLineEn: Invite stricture from auditors early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早邀請稽核責難。

members.speakLineEn: Restrict access to identifiable keys.
members.speakLineZh: 限制可識別金鑰存取。

members.speakLineEn: List every restriction in the registry.
members.speakLineZh: 在登錄庫列出每條限制。

members.speakLineEn: Restrictive NDAs block replication.
members.speakLineZh: 過緊保密協議阻擋複現。

members.speakLineEn: Constrain researcher degrees of freedom.
members.speakLineZh: 約束研究者自由度。

members.speakLineEn: Stringent checks beat stringency theater.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴厲檢查勝過嚴厲作秀。

members.speakLineEn: An astringent review can still be fair.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴苛審查仍可公平。

members.speakLineEn: Cordon off production data from playgrounds.
members.speakLineZh: 用封鎖線隔開正式資料與沙盒。

clusters.hook: 字根 struct＝建造——論證也是工程。
clusters.script: construct 建造，instruct 指導建造，destruct／destroy 拆毁，obstruct 阻擋施工。structure 結構，infrastructure 基礎建設，reconstruct 重建，restructure 改組。construction 構築物／解釋，destructive 破壞性，instructive 有教導性，superstructure 上層建築。

members.speakLineEn: Define the construct before choosing items.
members.speakLineZh: 選題目前先定義構念。

members.speakLineEn: Protocols instruct assistants on coding edge cases.
members.speakLineZh: 流程指示助理如何編碼邊界案例。

members.speakLineEn: One leak can destroy years of trust.
members.speakLineZh: 一次洩漏可毀掉多年信任。

members.speakLineEn: Missing metadata obstructs reuse.
members.speakLineZh: 缺中繼資料阻礙再利用。

members.speakLineEn: Argument structure should be visible in headings.
members.speakLineZh: 論證結構應在標題可見。

members.speakLineEn: Data infrastructure is part of scientific capital.
members.speakLineZh: 資料基礎設施是科學資本。

members.speakLineEn: Historians reconstruct events from partial archives.
members.speakLineZh: 史家從殘缺檔案重建事件。

members.speakLineEn: Restructure the paper around one sharp question.
members.speakLineZh: 圍繞一個尖銳問題重整論文。

members.speakLineEn: That legal construction stretches the text.
members.speakLineZh: 該法律解釋過度拉伸文本。

members.speakLineEn: Destructive criticism without alternatives stalls fields.
members.speakLineZh: 只有破壞無替代的批評讓領域停滯。

members.speakLineEn: Failed replications can be instructive.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗複現可以有啟發。

members.speakLineEn: Do not confuse rhetorical superstructure with identification.
members.speakLineZh: 别把修辭上層建築當成識別策略。

members.speakLineEn: Validate the instrument before scaling the survey.
members.speakLineZh: 放大調查前先驗證工具。

members.speakLineEn: Paywalls remain an obstruction to cumulative work.
members.speakLineZh: 付費牆仍是累積工作的障礙。

members.speakLineEn: Structural reforms beat one-off trainings.
members.speakLineZh: 結構改革勝過一次性訓練。

clusters.hook: 字根 suad＝勸——廣播站用甜嗓勸你，也用冷靜嗓勸你別衝動。
clusters.script: persuade／persuasion／persuasive 主頻道勸進。suave 滑順主持腔。assuage 安撫聽眾情緒；convince／coax／cajole／wheedle 說服家族客串——台長：persuasive writing 可以；cajole reviewers 用資料，不是奉承。

members.speakLineEn: Persuade with pre-specified analyses.
members.speakLineZh: 用預先指定分析來說服。

members.speakLineEn: Change of persuasion needs new evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 改變信念需要新證據。

members.speakLineEn: A persuasive figure still needs uncertainty.
members.speakLineZh: 有說服力的圖仍需不確定性。

members.speakLineEn: Suave talks cannot hide messy code.
members.speakLineZh: 圓滑演講藏不住混亂程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Assuage anxiety with open logs, not spin.
members.speakLineZh: 用開放日誌安撫焦慮，不是話術。

members.speakLineEn: Coax collaborators toward checklists kindly.
members.speakLineZh: 溫柔勸誘合作者使用清單。

members.speakLineEn: Do not cajole ethics boards with half-truths.
members.speakLineZh: 別用半真半假哄倫理委員會。

members.speakLineEn: Wheedle-free grants still need rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 不靠撒嬌的補助仍需嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: Keep the pitch shorter than the methods.
members.speakLineZh: 推銷稿要比方法段短。

members.speakLineEn: Softsoap cannot repair a broken protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 灌迷湯修不好破掉的規程。

clusters.hook: 字根 sum＝拿、總——提款機專管總結、消費、假定與傲慢帳單。
clusters.script: summary／summarize 列印總結小票。consume／consumer／consumption 把餘額花掉。assume／assumption 先假定密碼對。presumptuous 還沒刷卡就自以為VIP；sumptuous 豪華帳單——行員：assume 要寫明；presumptuous 語氣會被拒單。

members.speakLineEn: A summary must list limitations.
members.speakLineZh: 摘要必須列出限制。

members.speakLineEn: Summarize without erasing uncertainty.
members.speakLineZh: 總結時不要抹掉不確定性。

members.speakLineEn: Do not consume the whole alpha on fishing.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把 α 全花在淘篩上。

members.speakLineEn: Treat readers as skeptical consumers of claims.
members.speakLineZh: 把讀者當懷疑的主張消費者。

members.speakLineEn: Track compute consumption in methods.
members.speakLineZh: 方法段追蹤計算消耗。

members.speakLineEn: State what you assume about missingness.
members.speakLineZh: 說明你對缺失的假定。

members.speakLineEn: Every causal claim hides assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 每個因果主張都藏假設。

members.speakLineEn: It is presumptuous to skip preregistration.
members.speakLineZh: 跳過預註冊很僭越。

members.speakLineEn: Sumptuous prose cannot buy identification.
members.speakLineZh: 奢華文風買不到識別。

members.speakLineEn: Resume enrollment only after lock.
members.speakLineZh: 鎖定後才繼續收案。

members.speakLineEn: Do not claim a summit from one pilot.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用一次試點宣稱高峰。

members.speakLineEn: Report the sum of exclusions.
members.speakLineZh: 報告排除總和。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 surg＝升——手術室又處理浪潮上升，也處理外科切割。
clusters.script: surge／upsurge／resurgent／resurgence 浪潮監視器。surgeon／surgery／surgical 精準下刀；insurgency 叛亂升溫——主任：surgical edits 可以；hype surge 要止血。

members.speakLineEn: A surge in p-hacking follows vague plans.
members.speakLineZh: 計畫含糊後 p 黑客會湧現。

members.speakLineEn: An upsurge of interest is not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 興趣急升不是證據。

members.speakLineEn: Resurgent errors need stronger gates.
members.speakLineZh: 再起的錯誤需要更強閘門。

members.speakLineEn: Watch for resurgence of dropped outliers.
members.speakLineZh: 注意被丟掉離群值的再起。

members.speakLineEn: Be a surgeon of the analysis plan: precise cuts.
members.speakLineZh: 當分析計畫的外科醫生：精準下刀。

members.speakLineEn: Protocol surgery requires a change log.
members.speakLineZh: 規程手術需要變更日誌。

members.speakLineEn: Make surgical corrections, not silent rewrites.
members.speakLineZh: 做精準勘誤，不是沉默改寫。

members.speakLineEn: An insurgency of undocumented forks is toxic.
members.speakLineZh: 無文件分叉叛亂有毒。

members.speakLineEn: A rise in citations is not validity.
members.speakLineZh: 引用上升不是效度。

members.speakLineEn: Explain every spike before celebrating.
members.speakLineZh: 慶祝前先解釋每個尖峰。

members.speakLineEn: Use a scalpel on endpoints, not an axe.
members.speakLineZh: 對終點用手術刀，不用斧頭。

members.speakLineEn: Every incision in the sample needs a reason.
members.speakLineZh: 樣本每個切口需要理由。

flow.content: 字根 surg＝升——手術室又處理浪潮上升，也處理外科切割。

flow.name: 串記劇本
flow.content: surge／upsurge／resurgent／resurgence 浪潮監視器。surgeon／surgery／surgical 精準下刀；insurgency 叛亂升溫——主任：surgical edits 可以；hype surge 要止血。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 tact/tang＝觸——接待處專管接觸、策略、具體與完整。
clusters.script: tact／tactful／tactless 交際觸感。contact／intact 接觸／完整未碰壞。tangible／intangible 摸得到／摸不到。tangent 跑題切線；contingent 依條件觸發——接待：tactful critique；intact blinding。

members.speakLineEn: Use tact when requesting raw data.
members.speakLineZh: 索取原始資料要用圓通。

members.speakLineEn: Tactful emails still attach checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 圓通郵件仍附清單。

members.speakLineEn: Tactless sarcasm sinks valid points.
members.speakLineZh: 不得體諷刺毁掉有效論點。

members.speakLineEn: Document every contact with the data vendor.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄與資料供應商每次接觸。

members.speakLineEn: Keep blinding intact until lock.
members.speakLineZh: 鎖定前保持盲法完整。

members.speakLineEn: Give tangible deliverables: code and codebook.
members.speakLineZh: 給具體交付：程式碼與編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: Intangible prestige is not a methods argument.
members.speakLineZh: 無形聲望不是方法論據。

members.speakLineEn: Do not go on a tangent mid-prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊中途不要離題。

members.speakLineEn: Secondary analyses are contingent on the primary.
members.speakLineZh: 次要分析依主要結果而定。

members.speakLineEn: Tactile stickers on drives beat mystery folders.
members.speakLineZh: 硬碟觸覺貼紙勝過神秘資料夾。

members.speakLineEn: Keep contiguous logs without gaps.
members.speakLineZh: 保持毗連日誌無缺口。

members.speakLineEn: Attain power targets before recruitment ends.
members.speakLineZh: 招募結束前達成檢定力目標。

clusters.hook: 字根 techn＝技——工坊把技術、煙火與技術官僚放上同一張工作台。
clusters.script: technical／technique／technology／technician 工藝線。technocrat 技術官僚椅；pyrotechnics／polytechnic 煙火秀與綜合技校——師傅：technique > theatrics；technocrat 也不能免審。

members.speakLineEn: Technical debt in code becomes ethics debt.
members.speakLineZh: 程式技術債會變倫理債。

members.speakLineEn: Name the estimation technique plainly.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚命名估計技法。

members.speakLineEn: New technology still needs old checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 新科技仍需要舊清單。

members.speakLineEn: A careful technician beats a charismatic slide.
members.speakLineZh: 細心技術員勝過魅力簡報。

members.speakLineEn: A technocrat without humility ships bias.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有謙遜的技術官僚會產出偏差。

members.speakLineEn: Verbal pyrotechnics cannot hide missing data.
members.speakLineZh: 言語煙火藏不住缺失資料。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a polytechnic mix of skills on the team.
members.speakLineZh: 團隊保持綜合技術技能組合。

members.speakLineEn: Treat analysis as craft, not magic.
members.speakLineZh: 把分析當工藝，不是魔法。

members.speakLineEn: Invest in tooling for reproducibility.
members.speakLineZh: 投資可複現工具鏈。

members.speakLineEn: A fancy gadget is not a design.
members.speakLineZh: 花俏小裝置不是設計。

members.speakLineEn: Publish the blueprint with the build.
members.speakLineZh: 與建置一起公開藍圖。

clusters.hook: 字根 tele＝遠——傳送站專管遠距、遠望、遠寫與遠距上班。
clusters.script: television／telegraph／telemetry 遠距訊號。telegenic 上鏡臉；telecommute 遠距工位——站長：telemetry of decisions；別只 telegenic 不實測。

members.speakLineEn: Television timelines must not force peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 電視時程不該逼出偷看。

members.speakLineEn: Telegraph uncertainty in the abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 在摘要電報式標出不確定。

members.speakLineEn: Keep telemetry on who changed what when.
members.speakLineZh: 遙測誰在何時改了什麼。

members.speakLineEn: Telegenic charts still need axes.
members.speakLineZh: 上鏡圖表仍需要座標軸。

members.speakLineEn: Telecommute teams still share one repo clock.
members.speakLineZh: 遠距團隊仍共用一個 repo 時鐘。

members.speakLineEn: Distant effects need stronger identification.
members.speakLineZh: 遠距效應需要更強識別。

members.speakLineEn: Long-range claims need long-range data.
members.speakLineZh: 長程主張需要長程資料。

members.speakLineEn: Point the antenna at disconfirming evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 天線指向否證證據。

members.speakLineEn: State the prediction horizon before fitting.
members.speakLineZh: 擬合前說清預測地平線。

clusters.hook: 字根 tempor＝時——調度室專管暫時、當代、拖延與合時。
clusters.script: temporary 臨時通行證。contemporary 同時代同事。extemporaneous 即興發言（沒預寫）。temporize 拖時間和稀泥；tense／temporal：時間的——主任：temporary fix 要標日期；別 temporize 到錯過註冊窗。

members.senseAnchor: 暫時的；場面：臨時通行證
members.speakLineEn: Label temporary exclusions clearly.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚標示暫時排除。

members.speakLineEn: Cite contemporary standards for open data.
members.speakLineZh: 引用當代開放資料標準。

members.senseAnchor: 即興的；場面：沒預寫發言
members.speakLineEn: Extemporaneous analysis is fine if labeled exploratory.
members.speakLineZh: 即興分析可以，但要標探索性。

members.zhGloss: 行動躲閃以爭取時間；延長；拖延
members.senseAnchor: 行動躲閃以爭取時間；延長
members.speakLineEn: Do not temporize on correcting the record.
members.speakLineZh: 勘誤紀錄不要拖延觀望。

members.speakLineEn: Clarify temporal order for causality.
members.speakLineZh: 釐清時間順序以談因果。

members.speakLineEn: Slow the tempo of claims to match evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 把主張節奏降到匹配證據。

members.speakLineEn: Overtime coding without sleep breeds errors.
members.speakLineZh: 沒睡的加班編碼滋生錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Publish a timeline of protocol changes.
members.speakLineZh: 公開規程變更時間線。

members.speakLineEn: In the meantime, share interim documentation.
members.speakLineZh: 其間分享期中文件。

members.speakLineEn: Timely corrections beat perfect silence.
members.speakLineZh: 及時勘誤勝過完美沉默。

members.speakLineEn: Untimely peeking ruins blinding.
members.speakLineZh: 不合時偷看毀掉盲法。

members.speakLineEn: Temporarily embargo data only with reason.
members.speakLineZh: 僅在有理由時暫時禁運資料。

quiz.promptEn: Belonging to the same time; modern:

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 ten/tain＝持、握——誰抓得住誰。
clusters.script: tenacious 抓很緊；abstain 不伸手拿。retain 留住，maintain 維持，contain 裝住，obtain 取得。sustain 支撐住，pertain 相關聯，tenant 承租抓住空間，tenure 任期抓住職位，tenable 站得住，untenable 站不住，extend／tend 另族——這裡看 attention 把心抓住。

members.speakLineEn: Tenacious anomalies deserve another look.
members.speakLineZh: 頑強異常值得再看。

members.speakLineEn: Several members abstained from the vote.
members.speakLineZh: 數名成員投票棄權。

members.speakLineEn: Retain raw logs for auditability.
members.speakLineZh: 保留原始紀錄以便稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Maintain the same coding rules across waves.
members.speakLineZh: 各波次維持同一編碼規則。

members.speakLineEn: The model cannot contain every contextual factor.
members.speakLineZh: 模型無法裝下所有脈絡因素。

members.speakLineEn: Obtain consent before linking records.
members.speakLineZh: 連結紀錄前先取得同意。

members.speakLineEn: Can the budget sustain longitudinal follow-up?
members.speakLineZh: 預算撐得起縱貫追蹤嗎？

members.speakLineEn: Only variables that pertain to the hypothesis stay in.
members.speakLineZh: 只留與假說相關的變項。

members.senseAnchor: 承租人；場面：抓住空間的人
members.speakLineEn: Think of a theory as a tenant in the house of evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 把理論想成證據之屋的承租人。

members.speakLineEn: Tenure incentives can shape risk-taking in research.
members.speakLineZh: 終身職誘因會形塑研究冒險。

members.speakLineEn: Is the causal claim tenable under selection?
members.speakLineZh: 選擇偏差下因果主張站得住嗎？

members.speakLineEn: That reading becomes untenable once dates conflict.
members.speakLineZh: 日期衝突後該解讀站不住。

members.speakLineEn: Attention is a scarce resource in crowded literatures.
members.speakLineZh: 擁擠文獻裡注意力是稀缺資源。

members.speakLineEn: Results may not travel across continents without adaptation.
members.speakLineZh: 結果跨大陸未必不經適應就成立。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological detention of papers harms learning speed.
members.speakLineZh: 論文方法上的『扣留』傷害學習速度。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 tend/tens＝伸、張——拉力場專管拉長與張力。（有別於 ten＝握持）
clusters.script: extend 往外伸；contend 伸拳競爭。distend 脹開；tense／tension 拉緊。intense 強度拉滿；ostensible 表面上伸出來給人看。attend 把注意力伸過去；pretend 假裝伸一套戲。extensive 範圍伸很廣；tendency 傾向往哪伸。
pitfalls: ostensible＝表面宣稱，常暗示未必真

members.speakLineEn: Extend the follow-up window before claiming durability.
members.speakLineZh: 宣稱持久性前先延長追蹤窗。

members.speakLineEn: Authors contend that bias is bounded.
members.speakLineZh: 作者主張偏差有界。

members.speakLineEn: Hype can distend expectations beyond evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 炒作會把期望脹到超過證據。

members.speakLineEn: A tense deadline tempts cutting corners.
members.speakLineZh: 緊張期限誘使抄捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: There is productive tension between speed and rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 速度與嚴謹之間有生產性張力。

members.speakLineEn: Intense scrutiny should be fair, not theatrical.
members.speakLineZh: 強烈檢視應公平而非作秀。

members.speakLineEn: The ostensible reason masked a funding conflict.
members.speakLineZh: 表面理由掩蓋資助利益衝突。

members.speakLineEn: Attend to missingness patterns early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早注意缺失模式。

members.senseAnchor: 假裝；場面：伸一套假動作
members.speakLineEn: Do not pretend uncertainty is settled.
members.speakLineZh: 不要假裝不確定性已解決。

members.speakLineEn: Extensive robustness checks beat a single star.
members.speakLineZh: 廣泛穩健檢查勝過單一星號。

members.speakLineEn: There is a tendency to overfit narratives.
members.speakLineZh: 有對敘事過度擬合的傾向。

members.speakLineEn: A tensioned debate clarified operational definitions.
members.speakLineZh: 拉緊的辯論釐清操作型定義。

clusters.hook: 字根 term＝界、終——終點站專管術語、期限、終結與無盡。
clusters.script: term 術語／期限。terminate／terminal／termination 到站終結。interminable 彷彿永不到站。determine 劃定邊界；exterminate 極端滅除——站長：先 define terms，再 terminate 收案；interminable 會議請結束。

members.speakLineEn: Define every key term operationally.
members.speakLineZh: 每個關鍵術語都操作型定義。

members.speakLineEn: Terminal figures need readable axes.
members.speakLineZh: 終端圖需要可讀軸。

members.speakLineEn: Document termination criteria.
members.speakLineZh: 記錄終止標準。

members.speakLineEn: Interminable methods hide the procedure.
members.speakLineZh: 無盡方法段掩蓋程序。

members.speakLineEn: Determine the estimand before the model.
members.speakLineZh: 建模前測定目標量。

members.speakLineEn: Do not exterminate outliers without rules.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有規則不要消滅極端值。

members.speakLineEn: Align terminology across papers.
members.speakLineZh: 跨論文對齊術語。

members.speakLineEn: State the terminus of follow-up.
members.speakLineZh: 說明追蹤終點。

members.speakLineEn: Do not predetermine results in the intro.
members.speakLineZh: 不要在導論預先決定結果。

members.speakLineEn: Indeterminate missingness needs sensitivity analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 不確定缺失需要敏感度分析。

members.speakLineEn: Treat the registry deadline as sacred.
members.speakLineZh: 把登錄截止當神聖。

flow.name: 鉤子
flow.content: 字根 term＝界、終——終點站專管術語、期限、終結與無盡。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 terr＝地／怕——驚魂館一邊是土地，一邊是恐懼（依詞分流）。
clusters.script: terrain／territory／terrestrial 土地地圖。terrace 梯田看台。terror／terrible／terrify／terrorize 恐懼線。deter 嚇阻別靠近——導遊：territory 談地盤；terror 談害怕；別把 terrible writing 說成 terrain。
pitfalls: 同一拼寫族兩義：地 vs 怕

members.speakLineEn: Know the ethical terrain before scraping.
members.speakLineZh: 爬取前先摸清倫理地形。

members.speakLineEn: Respect disciplinary territory without silos.
members.speakLineZh: 尊重學科地盤但不築倉。

members.speakLineEn: Terrestrial labs still need cloud backups.
members.speakLineZh: 陸上實驗室仍需雲端備份。

members.speakLineEn: Build results as terraces of evidence, not cliffs of hype.
members.speakLineZh: 把結果建成證據梯田，不是炒作懸崖。

members.speakLineEn: Terror of retraction should not block corrections.
members.speakLineZh: 對撤稿的恐懼不該阻擋勘誤。

members.speakLineEn: Terrible documentation is a safety issue.
members.speakLineZh: 糟糕文件是安全問題。

members.speakLineEn: Do not terrify juniors for honest mistakes.
members.speakLineZh: 不要因誠實錯誤恐嚇資淺者。

members.speakLineEn: Sanctions can deter fabrication.
members.speakLineZh: 制裁能嚇阻捏造。

members.speakLineEn: Do not terrorize teams into fake positives.
members.speakLineZh: 不要恐嚇團隊做出假陽性。

members.speakLineEn: Extraordinary (even extraterrestrial) claims need evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 非凡（甚至外星）主張需要證據。

members.speakLineEn: Territorial data hoarding slows science.
members.speakLineZh: 地盤式囤資料拖慢科學。

flow.content: 字根 terr＝地／怕——驚魂館一邊是土地，一邊是恐懼（依詞分流）。

clusters.hook: 字根 test＝見證——檢察署專管作證、證詞、抗議與檢驗。
clusters.script: testify／testimony／testimonial 作證三件套。attest 連署見證。contest／protest 抗議比賽。detest 厭惡到拒絕作證——檢察官：attest 你的程式碼；protest 不公誘因；別 detest 陰性結果。

members.speakLineEn: Let the data testify, not the press release.
members.speakLineZh: 讓資料作證，不是新聞稿。

members.speakLineEn: Code is testimony; keep it readable.
members.speakLineZh: 程式碼是證詞；保持可讀。

members.speakLineEn: A celebrity testimonial is not validation.
members.speakLineZh: 名人見證文不是驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Attest that exclusions were pre-specified.
members.speakLineZh: 證明排除已預先指定。

members.speakLineEn: Contest shaky causal leaps.
members.speakLineZh: 爭辯不穩的因果跳躍。

members.speakLineEn: Protest paywalls that block replication.
members.speakLineZh: 抗議阻擋複現的付費牆。

members.speakLineEn: Detest fraud, not honest nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 厭惡造假，不是誠實虛無。

members.speakLineEn: Only testable claims belong in hypotheses.
members.speakLineZh: 只有可檢驗主張屬於假說。

members.speakLineEn: Every contestant metric needs a rulebook.
members.speakLineZh: 每個參賽指標需要規則書。

members.speakLineEn: Keep attestation of consent versions.
members.speakLineZh: 保留同意版本證明。

members.speakLineEn: Protestations of purity need audits.
members.speakLineZh: 純潔斷言需要稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Be a witness to protocol changes.
members.speakLineZh: 做規程變更的證人。

flow.name: 串記劇本
flow.content: testify／testimony／testimonial 作證三件套。attest 連署見證。contest／protest 抗議比賽。detest 厭惡到拒絕作證——檢察官：attest 你的程式碼；protest 不公誘因；別 detest 陰性結果。

clusters.hook: 字根 thesis＝放、命題——擂台左右是正題與反題，合成才是結局。
clusters.script: thesis 正方命題放上桌。antithesis 反方對打。synthesis 合成收場。hypothesis 待驗假說；parenthesis 括號旁白。prosthesis 義肢道具（詞源『放在前面』）——裁判：hypothesis 要可打；parenthesis 別塞進結局變項。

members.speakLineEn: State the thesis before the literature fog.
members.speakLineZh: 文獻迷霧前先陳述論題。

members.speakLineEn: Report the antithesis finding honestly.
members.speakLineZh: 誠實報告對立發現。

members.speakLineEn: A synthesis of replications beats one hit.
members.speakLineZh: 複現綜合勝過單次爆紅。

members.speakLineEn: Preregister the hypothesis, not the punchline.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊假說，不是笑點。

members.speakLineEn: Do not hide exclusions in a parenthesis.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把排除藏在括號裡。

members.speakLineEn: A statistical prosthesis cannot fix bad design.
members.speakLineZh: 統計義肢修不好壞設計。

members.speakLineEn: Keep hypotheticals labeled as such.
members.speakLineZh: 假設情境要標清楚。

members.speakLineEn: Synthesize evidence with explicit weights.
members.speakLineZh: 用明確權重綜合證據。

members.speakLineEn: Hypothesize before you peek.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看前先提出假說。

members.speakLineEn: A dissertation needs open materials.
members.speakLineZh: 學位論文需要開放材料。

members.speakLineEn: Write the counterthesis in the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 在討論寫反論題。

clusters.hook: 字根 tom＝切——解剖室專管切開、原子與百科切片。
clusters.script: atom／atomic 切到切不動。anatomy 結構解剖圖。tome 厚到像切下來的百科磚。epitome 典型切片代表；dichotomy 一刀兩半——主刀：dichotomy 前先定義；tome 別塞進摘要。

members.speakLineEn: An atom of evidence is still evidence—report it.
members.speakLineZh: 一原子證據仍是證據——請報告。

members.speakLineEn: Atomic commits help audits.
members.speakLineZh: 原子化提交幫助稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Show the anatomy of the pipeline.
members.speakLineZh: 展示管線解剖結構。

members.speakLineEn: Do not hide the protocol in a unread tome.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把規程藏在沒人讀的巨冊。

members.speakLineEn: That lab is the epitome of open sharing.
members.speakLineZh: 那實驗室是開放共享的典型。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid false dichotomies of 'significant or nothing'.
members.speakLineZh: 避免『顯著或什麼都不是』的假二分。

members.speakLineEn: Do an anatomy of error after retraction.
members.speakLineZh: 撤稿後做錯誤解剖。

members.speakLineEn: Cut exploratory claims from the abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 從摘要切開探索性主張。

members.speakLineEn: Slice the sample only by prereg rules.
members.speakLineZh: 僅依預註冊規則切片樣本。

members.speakLineEn: Section the paper so limits are visible.
members.speakLineZh: 切段論文讓限制可見。

members.speakLineEn: Dissect the identification assumptions.
members.speakLineZh: 細剖識別假設。

members.speakLineEn: Binary significance thinking is a trap.
members.speakLineZh: 二元顯著思維是陷阱。

clusters.hook: tort＝扭——說話反扭叫反駁，錢硬扭出來叫勒索。
clusters.script: 麻花師傅會 distort 真相的形狀；要錢時 extort 硬扭；別人一問他就 retort 反扭回去。路是 tortuous 彎來彎去，表情 contort 扭曲，內心長期 torment 折磨。
reviewHooks: tort＝扭：distort 扭形、extort 扭錢、retort 扭回、tortuous 扭路
tortuous（曲折）≠ torturous（折磨人的）——差一個字母
pitfalls: retort 可作動詞或名詞（機智反駁）

members.speakLineEn: Selective quotation can distort an author’s position.
members.speakLineZh: 選擇性引述會扭曲作者立場。

members.speakLineEn: The regime extorted confessions through threat.
members.speakLineZh: 政權以威脅勒索口供。

members.speakLineEn: She retorted that the critique ignored the data.
members.speakLineZh: 她反駁說批評忽略了數據。

members.speakLineEn: The tortuous reasoning lost the audience.
members.speakLineZh: 彎彎繞繞的推理讓聽眾掉線。

members.speakLineEn: He contorted the statute beyond recognition.
members.speakLineZh: 他把法條解釋扭到認不出原樣。

members.speakLineEn: Doubt continued to torment the researchers.
members.speakLineZh: 疑慮持續折磨研究人員。

members.speakLineEn: In the passage, torture signals a shift toward "折磨".
members.speakLineZh: 文中 torture 標示語氣轉向「折磨」。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would torsion basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會扭轉基本保障。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would extortion basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會勒索基本保障。

members.speakLineEn: Picture the 扭花: the word nasturtium means 旱金蓮.
members.speakLineZh: 想像「扭花」：nasturtium＝旱金蓮。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would torch basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會火炬基本保障。

content: tort＝扭：distort 扭形、extort 扭錢、retort 扭回、tortuous 扭路
tortuous（曲折）≠ torturous（折磨人的）——差一個字母

clusters.hook: 字根 tract＝拉、扯、拖——主角是拔河狂人。
clusters.script: 拔河狂人最會 attract 觀眾目光；一有風吹草動就 distract 對手。合約他要 protract 拖長，說過的話又能 retract 拉回肚子。別人一成功他就 detract 貶低；溫馴的叫 tractable，死都不肯被拉的叫 intractable。
reviewHooks: tract＝拉：吸引吸引過來、分心拉開、拖延拉長、撤回拉回、貶低往下拉
tractable 拉得動 ↔ intractable 拉不動
pitfalls: detract from = 減損……的價值；不要寫成『攻擊某人』的唯一義
retract（撤回說法／縮回）≠ retreat（撤退）
protract 偏『延長過程』，不是『保護 protect』

members.speakLineEn: Clear theses attract careful readers.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚的論旨能吸引細心的讀者。

members.speakLineEn: Irrelevant details distract from the main claim.
members.speakLineZh: 無關細節會把人從主論點拉開。

members.speakLineEn: They protracted negotiations to exhaust the other side.
members.speakLineZh: 他們拖延談判以消耗對方。

members.zhGloss: 縮回；撤回；正式收回前言
members.speakLineEn: The journal asked the authors to retract the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 期刊要求作者撤回該論文。

members.speakLineEn: One weak paragraph should not detract from the whole argument.
members.speakLineZh: 一段弱段落不該減損整篇論證。

members.zhGloss: 易駕馭的；溫順的；易處理的
members.speakLineEn: The problem looks more tractable after we define terms.
members.speakLineZh: 定義術語後，問題顯得更好處理。

members.speakLineEn: Poverty remains an intractable policy challenge.
members.speakLineZh: 貧困仍是棘手的政策挑戰。

members.speakLineEn: His leg was in traction for several days.
members.speakLineZh: 牽引。

members.speakLineEn: Let it be no detraction from his merits to say he is plainspoken.
members.speakLineZh: 貶低；貶損。

members.speakLineEn: A careful reader links extract to 提取, not a lookalike neighbor.
members.speakLineZh: 細心讀者把 extract 連到「提取」，不連形近鄰居。

members.speakLineEn: Picture the 契約: the word contract means 契約收縮.
members.speakLineZh: 想像「契約」：contract＝契約收縮。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would subtract basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會減去基本保障。

quiz.promptZh: 哪一個詞最接近「使某事顯得較不有價值／貶低」？

quiz.promptEn: A problem that is hard to manage is:
quiz.promptZh: 一個很難處理／駕馭的問題是：

clusters.hook: 字根 trib＝分、給——貢品處專管貢獻、分配、部落與苦難。
clusters.script: contribute／contribution／contributor 交貢品。distribute／distribution／tributary 分配支流。tribute 致敬貢品；tribe 部落櫃。tribulation 苦難關卡——處長：contribute 資料；distribute 功勞；tribulation 別靠造假渡。

members.speakLineEn: Contribute negative results too.
members.speakLineZh: 也貢獻陰性結果。

members.speakLineEn: State each author's contribution.
members.speakLineZh: 說明每位作者貢獻。

members.speakLineEn: List tool contributors in acknowledgments.
members.speakLineZh: 誌謝列出工具貢獻者。

members.speakLineEn: Distribute credit fairly.
members.speakLineZh: 公平分配功勞。

members.speakLineEn: Show the outcome distribution, not only means.
members.speakLineZh: 顯示結局分布，不只均值。

members.speakLineEn: Pay tribute to prior null replications.
members.speakLineZh: 向先前虛無複現致敬。

members.speakLineEn: A tributary analysis still needs disclosure.
members.speakLineZh: 支流分析仍需揭露。

members.speakLineEn: Method tribes should still share code.
members.speakLineZh: 方法部落仍應共享程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Peer review tribulation is not an excuse for opacity.
members.speakLineZh: 同儕審查苦難不是不透明的藉口。

members.speakLineEn: Redistribute compute time to replication.
members.speakLineZh: 把計算時間再分配給複現。

members.speakLineEn: Fix attribution before press.
members.speakLineZh: 發新聞前修正署名。

members.speakLineEn: Share protocols as living docs.
members.speakLineZh: 把規程當活文件分享。

clusters.hook: 字根 trud/trus＝推——閘門專管硬推、侵入、突出與抽象。
clusters.script: intrude／intrusion／intruder 硬闖閘門。obtrude／obtrusive 硬把東西推到眼前。protrude 往外突出。abstruse 推到抽象雲端看不懂；extrude 擠出成形——門衛：obtrusive 浮水印不行；abstruse 方法要翻譯。

members.speakLineEn: Do not intrude on blinded analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 不要侵入盲法分析。

members.speakLineEn: Data intrusion requires incident response.
members.speakLineZh: 資料侵入需要事故應變。

members.speakLineEn: Treat silent forks as protocol intruders.
members.speakLineZh: 把沉默分叉當規程入侵者。

members.senseAnchor: 突出的；場面：硬推到眼前
members.speakLineEn: Do not obtrude ideology onto measures.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把意識形態強加到測量。

members.speakLineEn: Outliers that protrude need rules, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 突出極端值需要規則不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: Extrude clear takeaways from dense tables.
members.speakLineZh: 從密集表擠出清楚重點。

members.speakLineEn: Thrust transparency into the workflow.
members.speakLineZh: 把透明推進工作流。

members.speakLineEn: Intrusive surveys need stronger consent.
members.speakLineZh: 侵擾式問卷需要更強同意。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer unobtrusive watermarks.
members.speakLineZh: 偏好不顯眼浮水印。

members.speakLineEn: Pushy claims invite skepticism.
members.speakLineZh: 硬推主張招來懷疑。

clusters.hook: 字根 turb＝擾——控制室專管擾動、混亂與干擾。
clusters.script: disturb／disturbance 擾動警報。turbulent 氣流亂；perturb 輕輕推亂。turbid 水混看不清；imperturbable 穩到擾不動——工程師：perturb 參數可以，disturb 原始日誌不行；寫作別 turbid。

members.speakLineEn: Do not disturb locked datasets.
members.speakLineZh: 不要擾亂已鎖定資料集。

members.speakLineEn: A protocol disturbance needs a version bump.
members.speakLineZh: 規程擾亂需要升版。

members.speakLineEn: Turbulent incentives reward flashy claims.
members.speakLineZh: 動盪誘因獎勵炫目主張。

members.speakLineEn: Perturb assumptions in sensitivity checks.
members.speakLineZh: 在敏感度檢查中微擾假設。

members.senseAnchor: 渾濁的；場面：水混看不清
members.speakLineEn: Turbid prose hides weak identification.
members.speakLineZh: 混濁文風掩蓋弱識別。

members.speakLineEn: Stay imperturbable when critique arrives.
members.speakLineZh: 批評到來時保持沉著。

members.speakLineEn: Lab turbulence rises after opaque decisions.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明決策後實驗室動盪上升。

members.speakLineEn: Report each perturbation of the plan.
members.speakLineZh: 報告計畫的每次微擾。

members.speakLineEn: Disturbing effect sizes need robustness.
members.speakLineZh: 令人不安的效應量需要穩健。

members.speakLineEn: Stir debate without stirring personal attacks.
members.speakLineZh: 攪動辯論但不攪動人身攻擊。

members.speakLineEn: Agitate for open norms, not for drama.
members.speakLineZh: 為開放規範煽動，不為戲劇。

members.speakLineEn: Keep a calm changelog voice.
members.speakLineZh: 變更紀錄保持平靜語氣。

clusters.script: umbrella 大傘遮一切（別濫用）。umbra／penumbra 本影與半影。adumbrate 先投下輪廓陰影。umbrage 生氣翻臉覺得被踩影——店員：adumbrate 限制；別 take umbrage 於誠實批評。

members.speakLineEn: An 'umbrella term' still needs definition.
members.speakLineZh: 總括詞仍需定義。

members.speakLineEn: Keep fraud in the umbra of zero tolerance.
members.speakLineZh: 造假放在零容忍本影裡。

members.speakLineEn: Ethics often lives in a penumbra of edge cases.
members.speakLineZh: 倫理常活在邊緣半影。

members.speakLineEn: Adumbrate the design in the abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 在摘要勾勒設計。

members.speakLineEn: Do not take umbrage at null results.
members.speakLineZh: 不要對虛無結果見怪。

members.speakLineEn: Shadow the analysis with a second coder.
members.speakLineZh: 用第二編碼者影子覆核分析。

members.speakLineEn: Shade uncertainty on the plot.
members.speakLineZh: 在圖上為不確定遮光。

members.speakLineEn: Do not let branding overshadow methods.
members.speakLineZh: 不要讓品牌壓過方法。

members.speakLineEn: Give a silhouette of the causal graph early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早給因果圖剪影。

members.speakLineEn: Clouds of jargon hide weak n.
members.speakLineZh: 行話雲遮住弱樣本。

members.speakLineEn: Do not eclipse limitations with celebrations.
members.speakLineZh: 不要用慶祝蓋過限制。

members.speakLineEn: Leaked IDs cast a shadow on trust.
members.speakLineZh: 外洩 ID 對信任投下陰影。

clusters.hook: 字根 urb＝城——風度局管都市、郊區，還有「urbane」那種都會禮貌。
clusters.script: urban／suburb／suburban／exurb／interurban 城市圈規劃。urbane／urbanity 都會風度課——局長：urbane rebuttals 可以；suburban folklore 不能當方法。

members.speakLineEn: Urban multi-site studies need site effects.
members.speakLineZh: 都市多站研究需要站點效應。

members.speakLineEn: Do not hide exclusions in a suburb of the appendix.
members.speakLineZh: 別把排除藏在附錄郊區。

members.speakLineEn: Suburban convenience samples limit transport.
members.speakLineZh: 郊區方便樣本限制外推。

members.senseAnchor: 彬彬有禮的；溫文都會的
members.speakLineEn: Urbane critique still names the error.
members.speakLineZh: 溫文批評仍要點名錯誤。

members.speakLineEn: Urbanity without honesty is empty polish.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有誠實的都雅是空拋光。

members.speakLineEn: Exurb collaborators need shared time zones rules.
members.speakLineZh: 遠郊合作者需要共享時區規則。

members.speakLineEn: Interurban replication networks share protocols.
members.speakLineZh: 城際複現網絡共享規程。

members.speakLineEn: Civic duty: correct the public record.
members.speakLineZh: 市民義務：更正公開紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: Metropolitan claims need metropolitan evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 大都會主張需要大都會證據。

members.speakLineEn: Keep primary results downtown, not in footnotes.
members.speakLineZh: 主要結果放市中心，不放腳註。

members.speakLineEn: Your skyline of figures should show uncertainty.
members.speakLineZh: 圖表天際線應顯示不確定性。

members.speakLineEn: Make the analysis boulevard one-way and signed.
members.speakLineZh: 讓分析大道單向且有路標。

clusters.hook: 字根 vac＝空——清潔站專管真空、空缺、假期與撤離。
clusters.script: vacant／vacancy 空位子。vacuum 真空袋。evacuate／evacuation 撤離現場。vacation／vacate 放假清空；vacuous 空洞發言——站長：vacuous claims 掃走；vacant rows 要標缺失。

members.speakLineEn: Mark vacant cells as missing, not zero.
members.speakLineZh: 空格標缺失，不要當零。

members.speakLineEn: A vacancy in the codebook invites miscodes.
members.speakLineZh: 編碼簿空缺誘發錯碼。

members.speakLineEn: There is no vacuum of assumptions—list them.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有假設真空——請列出。

members.speakLineEn: Evacuate secrets from public repos.
members.speakLineZh: 把秘密從公開 repo 撤離。

members.speakLineEn: Plan data evacuation before hardware fails.
members.speakLineZh: 硬體故障前先規劃資料撤離。

members.speakLineEn: Coverage does not take a vacation during holidays.
members.speakLineZh: 假期期間覆蓋率不放假。

members.speakLineEn: Vacate deprecated outcomes from the paper.
members.speakLineZh: 把棄用結局從論文騰空。

members.speakLineEn: Vacuous significance talk wastes space.
members.speakLineZh: 空洞顯著性空談浪費篇幅。

members.speakLineEn: A void in the audit trail voids trust.
members.speakLineZh: 稽核軌跡空隙使信任無效。

members.speakLineEn: Empty promises about sharing are misconduct-adjacent.
members.speakLineZh: 空頭分享承諾近似不端。

members.speakLineEn: A blank methods section fails review.
members.speakLineZh: 空白方法段審不過。

members.speakLineEn: Hollow metrics inflate resumes.
members.speakLineZh: 空心指標灌水履歷。

clusters.hook: 字根 vad/vas＝走——這條道要嘛衝進去，要嘛滑走開，瀰漫全場。
clusters.script: invade／invasion／invasive 衝進領地。evade／evasion／evasive 滑走閃答。pervade／pervasive 走遍每個角落；wade 涉水前進——道長：pervasive bias 要清；evasive answers 不及格。

members.speakLineEn: Do not invade privacy for a convenience win.
members.speakLineZh: 別為方便入侵隱私。

members.speakLineEn: An invasion of researcher degrees of freedom.
members.speakLineZh: 研究者自由度入侵警報。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer less invasive measures when possible.
members.speakLineZh: 可能時優先較少侵入的量測。

members.speakLineEn: Do not evade preregistration with vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 別用感覺規避預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Evasion in the limitations section is obvious.
members.speakLineZh: 限制段的閃躲很明顯。

members.speakLineEn: Evasive replies trigger deeper review.
members.speakLineZh: 閃爍回覆會觸發更深審查。

members.speakLineEn: Doubt should pervade extraordinary claims.
members.speakLineZh: 非凡主張該被懷疑瀰漫。

members.speakLineEn: Pervasive missingness needs a plan.
members.speakLineZh: 遍布缺失需要計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Wade through edge cases before launch.
members.speakLineZh: 上線前涉過邊界案例。

members.speakLineEn: Trespass into outcomes only with a plan.
members.speakLineZh: 只在有計畫時進入結局。

clusters.hook: 字根 vag＝遊——迷路站收留遊民、揮霍旅人，也抓「話太散」的分析。
clusters.script: vagrant／vagrancy／vagabond 遊民接待。extravagant／extravagance 揮霍旅費。divagate 離題散步；roam／ramble／meander 閒晃客串——站長：extravagant claims 要收據；divagate 可以，但要標探索。

members.speakLineEn: Vagrant hypotheses need a shelter: prereg.
members.speakLineZh: 流浪假說需要庇護所：預註冊。

members.speakLineEn: Statistical vagrancy is unplanned wandering.
members.speakLineZh: 統計遊蕩就是無計畫閒晃。

members.speakLineEn: A methods vagabond still carries a notebook.
members.speakLineZh: 方法流浪漢仍要帶筆記本。

members.speakLineEn: Extravagant claims need extravagant evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 過度主張需要過度證據。

members.speakLineEn: Cut extravagance in secondary endpoints.
members.speakLineZh: 削減次要終點的奢侈。

members.speakLineEn: Label when you divagate into exploration.
members.speakLineZh: 離題探索時請標註。

members.speakLineEn: Roam the literature, then lock the question.
members.speakLineZh: 先漫遊文獻，再鎖定問題。

members.speakLineEn: Do not ramble past the estimand.
members.speakLineZh: 別漫談到目標量之外。

members.speakLineEn: Meander in brainstorming, not in the final code.
members.speakLineZh: 腦力激盪可蜿蜒，最終程式不行。

members.speakLineEn: Nomadic analysts sync to one repo nightly.
members.speakLineZh: 遊牧分析師每晚同步到同一 repo。

members.speakLineEn: Watch for covariate drift across waves.
members.speakLineZh: 注意跨波次共變數漂移。

members.speakLineEn: Wayward tweaks belong in a sandbox.
members.speakLineZh: 任性微調屬於沙盒。

clusters.hook: 字根 val＝強／值——健身房專管價值、有效、勇敢與告別。
clusters.script: value／valuable／evaluate／evaluation 秤價值。valid／validate／validity 有效認證。valiant／valor 勇敢組。equivalent 等值啞鈴；prevail／invalid 勝出／無效——教練：validate openly；invalid shortcuts 禁。

members.speakLineEn: State the scientific value before the p.
members.speakLineZh: 在 p 之前陳述科學價值。

members.speakLineEn: Negative results are valuable when honest.
members.speakLineZh: 誠實的負結果有價值。

members.speakLineEn: Evaluate robustness, not vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 評估穩健，不是感覺。

members.speakLineEn: External evaluation beats self-praise.
members.speakLineZh: 外部評估勝過自誇。

members.speakLineEn: A valid test needs a clear estimand.
members.speakLineZh: 有效檢定需要清楚目標量。

members.speakLineEn: Validate code against a known toy dataset.
members.speakLineZh: 用已知玩具資料驗證程式碼。

members.speakLineEn: Discuss construct validity, not only p.
members.speakLineZh: 討論構念效度，不只 p。

members.speakLineEn: Valiant reporting includes limitations.
members.speakLineZh: 勇敢報告包含限制。

members.speakLineEn: Intellectual valor is correcting the record.
members.speakLineZh: 智識勇氣是更正紀錄。

members.speakLineEn: Do not treat proxies as equivalent outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 別把代理當等值結局。

members.speakLineEn: Evidence should prevail over hierarchy.
members.speakLineZh: 證據應勝過層級。

members.speakLineEn: Unblinded peeks make tests invalid.
members.speakLineZh: 非盲偷看使檢定無效。

clusters.hook: 字根 ven/vent＝來——人來了、氣出來了。
clusters.script: intervene 介入而來；convene 召集來到。invent 發明出來，prevent 搶先擋住到來。event 發生的事，adventure 冒險前來，revenue 進來的錢，avenue 大道，convenient 方便到來，venture 冒險投入，vent 出口出氣，contravene 違背對撞而來。

members.speakLineEn: When harm appears, protocols say when to intervene.
members.speakLineZh: 出現傷害時，流程規定何時介入。

members.speakLineEn: Convene the DSMB after unexpected deaths.
members.speakLineZh: 非預期死亡後召集安全委員會。

members.senseAnchor: 發明；場面：做出未來之物到來
members.speakLineEn: Do not invent subgroups after seeing outcomes.
members.speakLineZh: 看過結果後不要發明子群。

members.speakLineEn: Blinding can prevent some expectancy biases.
members.speakLineZh: 盲法可防止部分期望偏差。

members.senseAnchor: 事件；場面：到來發生的事
members.speakLineEn: Predefine adverse events of interest.
members.speakLineZh: 預先定義關注不良事件。

members.speakLineEn: Methodological adventure needs sharper safeguards.
members.speakLineZh: 方法冒險需要更利防護。

members.speakLineEn: Subscription revenue can conflict with open access.
members.speakLineZh: 訂閱收入可能與開放取用衝突。

members.speakLineEn: Preregistration is one avenue to credibility.
members.speakLineZh: 預註冊是可信度途徑之一。

members.speakLineEn: Convenient samples limit external claims.
members.speakLineZh: 方便樣本限制外部推論。

members.speakLineEn: Venture capital metaphors mislead basic science.
members.speakLineZh: 創投隱喻誤導基礎科學。

members.speakLineEn: Use the discussion to vent limitations, not excuses.
members.speakLineZh: 討論段發洩限制，不是藉口。

members.speakLineEn: Hidden exclusions contravene the protocol.
members.speakLineZh: 隱匿排除抵觸協議。

members.speakLineEn: Name the intervention dose and delivery.
members.speakLineZh: 說清介入劑量與交付。

members.speakLineEn: Prevention claims need absolute risk context.
members.speakLineZh: 預防宣稱需要絕對風險脈絡。

members.speakLineEn: The advent of cheap sequencing changed priors.
members.speakLineZh: 廉價定序到來改變先驗。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 verb＝字、詞——說話社專管用字、冗詞、逐字與諺語。
clusters.script: verbal／verbose 口頭說與說太多。verbatim 逐字照念。proverb／proverbial 諺語與諺語級。verbalize 把想法說出口；verbiage 字海淹人——社長：verbatim 引原文；verbose 摘要會被退件。

members.speakLineEn: Get verbal confirmation, then written consent.
members.speakLineZh: 先口頭確認再書面同意。

members.speakLineEn: Quote exclusions verbatim from the registry.
members.speakLineZh: 從登錄庫逐字引用排除。

members.speakLineEn: A proverb is not a causal law.
members.speakLineZh: 諺語不是因果定律。

members.speakLineEn: The proverbial 'statistically significant' trap.
members.speakLineZh: 眾所周知的『統計顯著』陷阱。

members.speakLineEn: Verbalize uncertainty in the abstract.
members.speakLineZh: 在摘要把不確定說出口。

members.speakLineEn: Drop marketing verbiage from claims.
members.speakLineZh: 主張刪掉行銷冗詞。

members.speakLineEn: An adverb like 'clearly' often hides doubt.
members.speakLineZh: 『清楚地』這類副詞常藏懷疑。

members.senseAnchor: 衆人皆知的；如諺語所說
members.speakLineEn: Proverbially hard problems still need n.
members.speakLineZh: 如諺語難的問題仍需要樣本。

members.speakLineEn: Precise diction beats ornate fog.
members.speakLineZh: 精確用字勝過華麗迷霧。

members.speakLineEn: Silence about exclusions is a red flag.
members.speakLineZh: 對排除沉默是紅旗。

flow.content: quiz ×3

clusters.hook: 字根 vert/vers＝轉——人生遙控器專管轉向。
clusters.script: 風向一變就 divert 轉向；危險來了趕緊 avert 轉開。政策 revert 轉回舊制，野心家想 subvert 從底下推翻。性格 perverse 老愛反著轉；世界觀是宇宙的 universe，一封信是寫給你的 verse 轉過來的詩行。
reviewHooks: vert＝轉：divert 轉開、avert 避開、revert 轉回、subvert 底下翻轉
perverse＝故意反著來；universe＝轉成一整體的世界
pitfalls: avert（轉開／避免）≠ advert（注意／廣告相關）
subvert 是顛覆體制，不是單純『轉個彎』

members.speakLineEn: The anecdote diverted attention from the weak premise.
members.speakLineZh: 這則軼事把注意力從薄弱前提轉開。

members.speakLineEn: Early warnings helped avert a larger crisis.
members.speakLineZh: 早期預警協助避免了更大危機。

members.speakLineEn: Without oversight, practices may revert to old habits.
members.speakLineZh: 缺少監督時，做法可能轉回舊習慣。

members.speakLineEn: Satire can subvert official narratives without direct attack.
members.speakLineZh: 諷刺能在不直接攻擊下顛覆官方敘事。

members.senseAnchor: 倔強的；場面：反著轉的性格
members.speakLineEn: A perverse reading ignores the plain sense of the text.
members.speakLineZh: 乖戾的解讀會忽略文本的平白意思。

members.speakLineEn: The study claims validity across a broad universe of cases.
members.speakLineZh: 該研究宣稱在廣泛案例宇宙中皆有效。

members.speakLineEn: A versatile method travels across disciplines.
members.speakLineZh: 多用途方法能跨領域旅行。

members.speakLineEn: Adverse incentives warped the reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 不利的誘因扭曲了通報。

members.speakLineEn: The anniversary essay revisited the founding debate.
members.speakLineZh: 週年紀念文重訪了創立時的辯論。

members.senseAnchor: 爭議；場面：意見轉來轉去打結
members.speakLineEn: The controversy turned on how to define harm.
members.speakLineZh: 爭議聚焦在如何定義傷害。

members.speakLineEn: An introvert may still lead through careful writing.
members.speakLineZh: 內向者仍可透過審慎寫作領導。

quiz.promptEn: To prevent a disaster by turning it aside is to:
To undermine a system from within is to:

flow.name: 串記劇本

perverse＝故意反著來；universe＝轉成一整體的世界

clusters.hook: 字根 via＝路——分岔口專管路徑、偏離、顯而易見與穿不透。
clusters.script: via 路徑標。deviate／deviation／deviant 偏離道。previous／trivial／obvious 前一路與顯而易見牌；impervious／pervious 穿不透／可滲——交警：report deviation；impervious egos 禁行。

members.speakLineEn: Share files via a versioned vault, not chat.
members.speakLineZh: 經由版本庫分享檔案，不是聊天。

members.speakLineEn: Do not deviate from the plan silently.
members.speakLineZh: 不要沉默偏離計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Log every deviation with a timestamp.
members.speakLineZh: 每筆偏離記錄時間戳。

members.speakLineEn: Label deviant analyses as exploratory.
members.speakLineZh: 把非常規分析標為探索。

members.speakLineEn: Cite previous locks of the same dataset.
members.speakLineZh: 引用同一資料集先前鎖定。

members.speakLineEn: A trivial bug can still bias estimates.
members.speakLineZh: 瑣碎 bug 仍可能偏差估計。

members.speakLineEn: If it is obvious, still show the check.
members.speakLineZh: 即使明顯，仍展示檢查。

members.zhGloss: 不可滲透的；不可穿透的
members.senseAnchor: 不可滲透的；不可穿透的
members.speakLineEn: Do not be impervious to critique.
members.speakLineZh: 不要對批評無動於衷。

members.speakLineEn: Keep leadership pervious to junior flags.
members.speakLineZh: 讓領導層可被資淺舉旗滲透。

members.speakLineEn: Draw the causal pathway before the model.
members.speakLineZh: 建模前畫因果通路。

members.speakLineEn: Detours need signs in the supplement.
members.speakLineZh: 繞道需要在補充材料立牌。

members.speakLineEn: At each crossroad, write the decision rule.
members.speakLineZh: 每個十字路口寫下決策規則。

clusters.hook: 字根 vid/vis＝看——誰看得見證據。
clusters.script: evident 明顯可見；provide 預先看顧供應，providence／provident 遠見。revise 再看修改，supervise 監督看管，visage 臉容，visible 可見，vision 願景／視力，visit 走看，visual 視覺的，evidence 可見憑據，improvisation 臨時看著辦，invidious 招忌的比較。

members.speakLineEn: Selection is evident from the attrition table.
members.speakLineZh: 從耗損表可明顯見選擇。

members.senseAnchor: 提供；場面：預先看顧而給
members.speakLineEn: Provide code that runs on a clean machine.
members.speakLineZh: 提供能在乾淨機器跑的程式。

members.speakLineEn: Provident archiving saves future labs.
members.speakLineZh: 有遠見的典藏拯救未來實驗室。

members.speakLineEn: Revise claims after the robustness battery.
members.speakLineZh: 穩健電池後再修訂主張。

members.speakLineEn: Supervise labeling to reduce drift.
members.speakLineZh: 監督標註以減少漂移。

members.speakLineEn: Do not judge a paper by journal visage alone.
members.speakLineZh: 別只靠期刊臉判斷論文。

members.speakLineEn: Make assumptions visible in a box.
members.speakLineZh: 把假設放進框裡看得見。

members.speakLineEn: A vision without metrics is a poster.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有指標的願景只是海報。

members.speakLineEn: Visit the raw traces before summarizing.
members.speakLineZh: 摘要前先看原始軌跡。

members.senseAnchor: 視覺的；場面：用眼睛看的
members.speakLineEn: Visual clutter undermines chart honesty.
members.speakLineZh: 視覺雜訊破壞圖表誠實。

members.senseAnchor: 證據；場面：看得見的憑據
members.speakLineEn: Evidence outweighs eloquence.
members.speakLineZh: 證據重於雄辯。

members.speakLineEn: Do not improvise exclusion rules after peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 偷看後不要即興訂排除規則。

members.speakLineEn: Invidious rankings ignore uncertainty.
members.speakLineZh: 招忌排名忽略不確定性。

members.speakLineEn: Videotape coding training for reliability audits.
members.speakLineZh: 為信度稽核錄下編碼訓練。

members.speakLineEn: Visibility of negative results is still uneven.
members.speakLineZh: 負結果可見度仍不均。

clusters.hook: 字根 vinc/vict＝勝——競技場專管誰被說服、誰被擊敗。
clusters.script: victor／victory 勝者。convict 定罪勝過辯護；evict 趕出勝出空間。convince 說服取勝；invincible 打不敗。vanquish 徹底打垮；provincial 眼界窄像地方小勝。eviction 驅逐令；conviction 信念／定罪；victorious 勝利的。
reviewHooks: convict 可作動詞定罪或名詞囚犯
pitfalls: provincial 常指眼界狹窄，不只「省的」

members.speakLineEn: The victor narrative ignored failed pilots.
members.speakLineZh: 勝者敘事忽略失敗試點。

members.speakLineEn: A statistical victory is not a policy victory.
members.speakLineZh: 統計勝利不是政策勝利。

members.speakLineEn: You cannot convict a theory on one noisy study.
members.speakLineZh: 不能靠一項嘈雜研究給理論定罪。

members.speakLineEn: Evict redundant predictors after justification.
members.speakLineZh: 說明理由後驅逐冗餘預測變項。

members.speakLineEn: Graphs convince more than p-values alone.
members.speakLineZh: 圖比單靠 p 值更能說服。

members.speakLineEn: No method is invincible against bad measurement.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有方法能戰勝糟糕測量。

members.speakLineEn: New evidence can vanquish a fashionable model.
members.speakLineZh: 新證據能打垮流行模型。

members.senseAnchor: 狹隘的；場面：小地方視野
members.speakLineEn: A provincial reading misses cross-cultural tests.
members.speakLineZh: 狹窄解讀錯過跨文化檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: Variable eviction needs pre-specified rules.
members.speakLineZh: 變項驅逐需要預先規則。

members.speakLineEn: Write with conviction, revise with doubt.
members.speakLineZh: 寫作帶信念，修改帶懷疑。

members.speakLineEn: A victorious press release oversold the RCT.
members.speakLineZh: 得勝新聞稿過度銷售隨機試驗。

members.speakLineEn: Do not analogize p-hacking to a conviction rate casually.
members.speakLineZh: 不要隨便把 p 操弄類比定罪率。

clusters.hook: 字根 viv/vit＝活——維生站專管活力、生還、生動與維生素梗。
clusters.script: vivid 畫面活跳。survive／survival／survivor 活過關卡。revive 急救回魂；vital／vitality 要命的重要與活力。vivacious 活潑店員——站長：vital 限制要寫；vivid 例子幫忙；survive 複現戰。

members.speakLineEn: Use vivid examples without overselling.
members.speakLineZh: 用生動例子但不過度銷售。

members.speakLineEn: Only transparent projects survive audits.
members.speakLineZh: 只有透明專案撐過稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Report survival of findings under reanalysis.
members.speakLineZh: 報告發現在再分析下的存活。

members.speakLineEn: Treat retracted papers as teaching survivors.
members.speakLineZh: 把撤稿當教學倖存者。

members.speakLineEn: Revive abandoned protocols with care.
members.speakLineZh: 謹慎重振被棄規程。

members.speakLineEn: Vital assumptions belong up front.
members.speakLineZh: 要命假設放最前面。

members.speakLineEn: Open critique keeps a field's vitality.
members.speakLineZh: 開放批評保持領域活力。

members.speakLineEn: Vivacious talks still need sober slides.
members.speakLineZh: 活潑演講仍需清醒投影片。

members.speakLineEn: Think of checklists as vitamins for methods.
members.speakLineZh: 把檢核表當方法維生素。

members.speakLineEn: Revive debate on estimands yearly.
members.speakLineZh: 每年重啟目標量辯論。

members.speakLineEn: Keep documentation alive with versions.
members.speakLineZh: 用版本讓文件保持活。

members.speakLineEn: Shared code is a replication lifeline.
members.speakLineZh: 共享程式碼是複現生命線。

clusters.hook: 字根 voc/vok＝呼、叫——整棟樓都是對講機。
clusters.script: 你 invoke 呼叫權威來站台；對手 provoke 挑釁你出聲。會議 convoke 把人召來，權利被 revoke 撤銷就消音。vocabulary 是你的詞彙武器庫，vocal 是出聲音的；equivocal 一句話兩種叫聲，univocal 只有一種意思。
reviewHooks: voc＝叫：invoke 请来、provoke 激怒出聲、convoke 召開、revoke 撤聲／撤權
equivocal 模稜兩可 ↔ univocal 單一明確
pitfalls: invoke（援引／祈求）≠ evoke（喚起情感）——evoke 已在 rhyme-eak 族
revoke 與 evoke 尾韻像，方向相反：收回 vs 喚起

members.speakLineEn: The brief invokes precedent from earlier rulings.
members.speakLineZh: 訴狀援引了先前裁定作為先例。

members.speakLineEn: The remark was meant to provoke a reaction, not illuminate.
members.speakLineZh: 那句話意在激起反應，而非澄清。

members.speakLineEn: Leaders convoked an emergency panel.
members.speakLineZh: 領導人召集了緊急小組。

members.roleInScript: 把你從正職叫走的嗜好
members.speakLineEn: Poetry remained his avocation, not his livelihood.
members.speakLineZh: 詩仍是他的副業嗜好，不是生計。

members.senseAnchor: 詞彙；場面：可呼叫的詞庫
members.speakLineEn: A precise vocabulary reduces equivocation.
members.speakLineZh: 精確詞彙能減少模稜兩可。

members.speakLineEn: Vocal critics forced a policy rewrite.
members.speakLineZh: 直言批評者迫使政策重寫。

members.speakLineEn: An equivocal answer delayed the decision.
members.speakLineZh: 模稜兩可的回答拖延了決定。

members.speakLineEn: The statute is rarely univocal in application.
members.speakLineZh: 法條在適用上很少是單義明確的。

members.speakLineEn: She advocates transparent peer review.
members.speakLineZh: 她提倡透明的同儕審查。

members.speakLineEn: Vociferous objections filled the hearing.
members.speakLineZh: 喧嘩反對聲充滿聽證會。

members.senseAnchor: 無法撤回的；不可撤銷的
members.speakLineEn: The resignation was framed as irrevocable.
members.speakLineZh: 辭呈被定性為不可撤銷。

clusters.hook: 字根 vol＝願／飛——塔台左頻是意願，右頻是飛行（依詞分流）。
clusters.script: voluntary／volunteer 自願登機。volition 意願操縱桿。benevolent／malevolent（他族）提醒好壞意願。volatile 脾氣／市況易飛走；volley 對打飛球；volume 音量飛高——塔台：voluntary consent；volatile claims 要繫安全帶。

members.speakLineEn: Participation must be voluntary and informed.
members.speakLineZh: 參與必須自願且知情。

members.speakLineEn: Volunteer coders still need credit.
members.speakLineZh: 志願寫碼者仍需署名。

members.speakLineEn: Fraud is a choice of volition, not accident.
members.speakLineZh: 造假是意志選擇不是意外。

members.speakLineEn: Volatile metrics need version pins.
members.speakLineZh: 易變指標需要版本釘死。

members.speakLineEn: A volley of critiques should stay on methods.
members.speakLineZh: 齊發批評應停在方法上。

members.speakLineEn: Turn down the volume of hype.
members.speakLineZh: 把炒作音量調低。

members.speakLineEn: Involuntary data reuse needs fresh consent.
members.speakLineZh: 非自願資料再利用需新同意。

members.speakLineEn: Report estimate volatility across specs.
members.speakLineZh: 報告跨規格估計波動。

members.speakLineEn: Ideas that cannot fly without secrecy fail science.
members.speakLineZh: 靠保密才能飛的想法不符科學。

members.speakLineEn: Willpower alone cannot replace checklists.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠意志力不能取代檢核表。

members.speakLineEn: Be willing to publish nulls.
members.speakLineZh: 願意發表虛無結果。

members.speakLineEn: Unwilling data sharing stalls replications.
members.speakLineZh: 不願共享資料拖延複現。

clusters.hook: 字根 vor＝吃——食堂怪獸依食譜分類：雜食、肉食、吞食。
clusters.script: voracious 食欲怪獸。devour 整盤吞。carnivore／herbivore／omnivore 肉／草／雜食窗口。savory 鹹香好吃（非 vor 但同桌）；vortex 漩渦把東西吃進去——廚師：voracious reading 好；devour 證據別只吞摘要。

members.speakLineEn: Be voracious for primary sources.
members.speakLineZh: 對一手來源如饑似渴。

members.zhGloss: 吞食；狼吞虎嚥；也可指如饑似渴地讀
members.speakLineEn: Do not devour only abstracts.
members.speakLineZh: 不要只吞摘要。

members.speakLineEn: A methods carnivore still needs veggies of ethics.
members.speakLineZh: 方法肉食者仍需倫理蔬菜。

members.speakLineEn: Herbivore patience fits long replications.
members.speakLineZh: 草食耐心適合長複現。

members.speakLineEn: An omnivore toolkit still needs coherence.
members.speakLineZh: 雜食工具箱仍需一貫。

members.speakLineEn: Avoid the vortex of endless metrics.
members.speakLineZh: 避開無盡指標漩渦。

members.speakLineEn: Devouring hype leaves no room for limits.
members.speakLineZh: 狂吞炒作就塞不下限制。

members.speakLineEn: Savory narratives still need salt of doubt.
members.speakLineZh: 可口敘事仍需懷疑的鹽。

members.speakLineEn: Do not be a glutton for covariates.
members.speakLineZh: 不要當共變項暴食者。

members.speakLineEn: Digest critique overnight before replying.
members.speakLineZh: 回覆前隔夜消化批評。

members.speakLineEn: Binge-reading without notes wastes time.
members.speakLineZh: 不筆記的狂讀浪費時間。

clusters.hook: 一邊玻璃窗，一邊霧玻璃——GRE 最愛考『說得清不清』。
clusters.script: 清晰：lucid、explicit、perspicuous、transparent。晦澀：obscure、opaque、ambiguous、equivocal（voc 族已練）、vague、abstruse、recondite。用對打一次記兩排。
pitfalls: opaque 可指不透明或難懂

members.speakLineEn: A lucid limitation section builds trust.
members.speakLineZh: 清晰限制段建立信任。

members.speakLineEn: Be explicit about missing-data rules.
members.speakLineZh: 缺值規則要明確。

members.speakLineEn: Prefer perspicuous diagrams over ornament.
members.speakLineZh: 寧可明白圖，不要裝飾。

members.speakLineEn: Transparent pipelines enable audit.
members.speakLineZh: 透明管線可稽核。

members.speakLineEn: Jargon can obscure a simple design flaw.
members.speakLineZh: 行話會遮掩簡單設計缺陷。

members.speakLineEn: Opaque preprocessing invites distrust.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明前處理招致不信。

members.speakLineEn: Ambiguous items destroy interrater reliability.
members.speakLineZh: 模稜題項摧毀評分者信度。

members.speakLineEn: Vague hypotheses cannot fail.
members.speakLineZh: 含糊假說不會失敗。

members.speakLineEn: Abstruse prose is not rigor.
members.speakLineZh: 深奧難解文筆≠嚴謹。

members.speakLineEn: Recondite citations should still be findable.
members.speakLineZh: 隱僻引用仍應可找到。

members.senseAnchor: 隱含的；場面：沒寫在外面
members.speakLineEn: Make implicit assumptions explicit.
members.speakLineZh: 把隱含假設說明白。

members.speakLineEn: Clarity is a ethical duty in consent.
members.speakLineZh: 同意書裡清晰是倫理義務。

members.speakLineEn: A nebula of buzzwords is not a theory.
members.speakLineZh: 術語星雲不是理論。

members.speakLineEn: Crystal-clear stopping rules prevent peeking.
members.speakLineZh: 水晶般清楚的停止規則防偷看。

members.speakLineEn: Muddy contrasts weaken identification stories.
members.speakLineZh: 混濁對照削弱識別故事。

clusters.titleZh: 勇敢 ↔ 怯懦｜勇氣擂台
clusters.hook: 擂台左邊 intrepid／dauntless 往前衝；右邊 craven／timorous 往後縮——記住褒貶語氣。
clusters.script: 勇敢隊：intrepid／dauntless／valorous／plucky／audacious 衝去公開虛無。怯懦隊：craven／timorous／pusillanimous／trepidation／timid 害怕勘誤——裁判：audacious 可以是勇敢或魯莽，看語境。

members.speakLineEn: Intrepid reporting includes ugly limitations.
members.speakLineZh: 無畏報告包含難看的限制。

members.speakLineEn: Stay dauntless when the primary fails.
members.speakLineZh: 主要終點失敗時保持無懼。

members.speakLineEn: Valorous science corrects itself in public.
members.speakLineZh: 英勇科學公開自我更正。

members.speakLineEn: Plucky juniors should be rewarded for flags.
members.speakLineZh: 倔強資淺者舉旗應被獎勵。

members.speakLineEn: Audacious claims need audacious evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 大膽主張需要大膽證據。

members.speakLineEn: Craven silence after an error is misconduct-adjacent.
members.speakLineZh: 錯誤後懦弱沉默近似不端。

members.speakLineEn: Timorous teams hide deviations.
members.speakLineZh: 膽怯團隊隱藏偏離。

members.speakLineEn: Pusillanimous leadership punishes messengers.
members.speakLineZh: 卑怯領導懲罰報信者。

members.speakLineEn: Trepidation before opening the envelope is healthy.
members.speakLineZh: 打開信封前的惶恐是健康的。

members.speakLineEn: Timid abstracts that hide uncertainty mislead.
members.speakLineZh: 隱藏不確定的膽小摘要會誤導。

members.speakLineEn: Be bold about sharing code.
members.speakLineZh: 分享程式碼要大膽。

members.speakLineEn: Fearless transparency beats perfect vibes.
members.speakLineZh: 無畏透明勝過完美感覺。

clusters.hook: 一邊跪著誇，一邊用睫毛從天花板瞪你。
clusters.script: 辦公室裡 sycophant／toady 會 fawn 巴結；對面座位坐著 arrogant、supercilious、imperious 的主管，睫毛好像長在額頭上往下掃視。

pitfalls: fawn 另有『小鹿』義，考試多為動詞巴結
sycophant 諧音可記，但答題要回到『諂媚者』

members.zhGloss: 諂媚者；馬屁精；奉承討好
members.speakLineEn: A sycophant praises power, not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚者歌頌的是權力，不是證據。

members.speakLineEn: He dismissed the aide as a political toady.
members.speakLineZh: 他把那名助理斥為政治馬屁精。

members.speakLineEn: Junior analysts should not fawn over every fashion in theory.
members.speakLineZh: 初級分析師不該對每個理論時尚巴結奉承。

members.speakLineEn: An arrogant tone can sink an otherwise sound argument.
members.speakLineZh: 傲慢語氣可能毁掉本來站得住的論證。

members.speakLineEn: Her supercilious smile dismissed the objection.
members.speakLineZh: 她目空一切的笑把異議掃掉。

members.senseAnchor: 傲慢的；場面：命令式傲嬌
members.speakLineEn: An imperious email rarely invites collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 專橫的郵件很少帶來合作。

members.speakLineEn: In the passage, disdainful signals a shift toward "輕蔑的".
members.speakLineZh: 文中 disdainful 標示語氣轉向「輕蔑的」。

clusters.titleZh: 給予 ↔ 剝奪｜禮物桌對沒收筐
clusters.hook: endow／bestow 把禮物擺上桌，divest／despoil／bereave 把東西丟進沒收筐——禮賓說：進門有禮，出門看筐。
clusters.script: 給予隊：endow／bestow／confer／grant。剝奪隊：divest／despoil／bereave／disenfranchise／deprive。口令：禮物桌寫「給你能耐」，沒收筐寫「先收回資格」。

clusters.hook: 語義對打：公開可見 vs 偷偷摸摸——考場超愛對照。
clusters.script: 公開隊：overt 公開，patent／manifest 明顯，transparent 透明。隱密隊：covert 隱蔽，clandestine 祕密，surreptitious／furtive 偷偷摸摸，latent／occult 潛藏，stealth 隱身。
pitfalls: patent 可指明顯或專利，看語境

members.speakLineEn: Overt preregistration beats private plans.
members.speakLineZh: 公開預註冊勝過私下計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Covert multiple testing inflates false positives.
members.speakLineZh: 隱蔽多重檢定膨脹偽陽性。

members.speakLineEn: Clandestine data edits should be impossible.
members.speakLineZh: 暗中改資料應不可能。

members.speakLineEn: Surreptitious outcome switching is misconduct.
members.speakLineZh: 偷偷更換結局變項是不端。

members.speakLineEn: Furtive glances at interim results bias stopping.
members.speakLineZh: 鬼祟偷看期中結果扭曲停損。

members.speakLineEn: The flaw was patent in the raw scatterplot.
members.speakLineZh: 缺陷在原始散點圖上很明顯。

members.speakLineEn: Bias became manifest after stratification.
members.speakLineZh: 分層後偏差顯現。

members.speakLineEn: Latent classes need strong identification.
members.speakLineZh: 潛在類別需要強識別。

members.speakLineEn: Do not treat statistical noise as occult wisdom.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把統計噪音當隱秘智慧。

members.speakLineEn: Stealth revisions without changelogs erode trust.
members.speakLineZh: 無變更紀錄的隱密修訂侵蝕信任。

clusters.hook: 語義對打：誇到天上 vs 罵到落地——GRE 語氣超愛這組。
clusters.script: 讚美隊：laud／acclaim／commend／applaud／eulogize／panegyric／encomium——頒獎典禮模式。責罵隊：condemn／reprove／rebuke／castigate／upbraid／lambaste——法庭咆哮模式。口令：讚要具體，罵要對事。
pitfalls: eulogize 常＝頌揚（可含悼詞義）

members.speakLineEn: Laud the replication, not only the novelty.
members.speakLineZh: 讚美複現，不只新奇。

members.speakLineEn: Critical acclaim is not validation.
members.speakLineZh: 批評界歡呼不是驗證。

members.speakLineEn: Commend transparent limitation sections.
members.speakLineZh: 表揚透明的限制段。

members.speakLineEn: Applaud corrections as courage.
members.speakLineZh: 把勘誤當勇氣鼓掌。

members.speakLineEn: Do not eulogize a living theory past its data.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把活理論頌揚超過資料。

members.speakLineEn: A panegyric abstract oversells.
members.speakLineZh: 頌詞式摘要過度銷售。

members.speakLineEn: Save encomiums for after audit.
members.speakLineZh: 稽核後再寫讚辭。

members.speakLineEn: Condemn fabrication unequivocally.
members.speakLineZh: 毫不含糊譴責捏造。

members.speakLineEn: Reprove sloppy logs early.
members.speakLineZh: 及早責備草率日誌。

members.speakLineEn: A public rebuke needs due process.
members.speakLineZh: 公開斥責需要正當程序。

members.speakLineEn: Castigate incentives, then fix them.
members.speakLineZh: 嚴厲譴責誘因，然後修好。

members.speakLineEn: Lambaste hype in methods clubs.
members.speakLineZh: 在方法讀書會痛罵炒作。

clusters.hook: 一邊痛到倒吸涼氣說不出話，一邊嘎嚕嚕叫不停。
clusters.script: 會議室左排 taciturn、reticent、laconic——能不說就不說；右排 loquacious、garrulous、verbose——停不下來。語義對打：兩邊語氣相反，考試選「褒貶／強弱」對的那側。登場：taciturn（倒吸涼氣派）、reticent（有話留半句）、laconic（短到像密碼）、loquacious（話匣子）、garrulous（嘎嚕嚕老母雞）、verbose（字數膨脹）。
pitfalls: reticent 強調『不願透露』；taciturn 強調『生性少話』
loquacious 中性偏多話；garrulous 更嫌喋喋

members.senseAnchor: 沉默的；場面：倒吸涼氣派
members.speakLineEn: The taciturn witness answered in monosyllables.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默的證人只用單音節回答。

members.speakLineEn: She remained reticent about her funding sources.
members.speakLineZh: 她對資金來源仍不輕易透露。

members.senseAnchor: 簡短的；場面：短到像密碼
members.speakLineEn: His laconic reply ended the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 他言簡意賅的回覆結束了討論。

members.speakLineEn: A loquacious narrator can bury the plot.
members.speakLineZh: 滔滔不絕的敘事者可能把情節埋掉。

members.senseAnchor: 話多的；場面：嘎嚕嚕老母雞
members.speakLineEn: The garrulous memoir digresses endlessly.
members.speakLineZh: 這本喋喋不休的回憶錄沒完没了地離題。

members.speakLineEn: Cut verbose transitions; keep the claim sharp.
members.speakLineZh: 刪掉冗長過渡，讓論點保持鋒利。

members.speakLineEn: A careful reader links chatty to 愛聊天的, not a lookalike neighbor.
members.speakLineZh: 細心讀者把 chatty 連到「愛聊天的」，不連形近鄰居。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would prattle basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會閒聊基本保障。

clusters.titleZh: 脾氣暴躁 ↔ 和藹可親
clusters.hook: 熱可樂一開就炸，對面卻始終春風笑。
clusters.script: 左邊 choleric、irascible、peevish——點火就爆；右邊 affable、genial、amiable——誰來都好說話。語義對打：兩邊語氣相反，考試選「褒貶／強弱」對的那側。登場：choleric（熱可樂炸彈）、irascible（點火就著）、peevish（碎碎念易怒）、affable（好說話笑臉）、genial（溫暖氣場）、amiable（好相處）。
pitfalls: amiable 指人緣好；amicable 常指關係／協議和睦——形近

members.senseAnchor: 易怒的；場面：熱可樂炸彈
members.speakLineEn: A choleric referee escalated every dispute.
members.speakLineZh: 易怒的裁判讓每個爭議都升級。

members.speakLineEn: The irascible professor dismissed soft questions.
members.speakLineZh: 暴躁教授直接打發軟問題。

members.speakLineEn: Peevish objections rarely improve the draft.
members.speakLineZh: 壞脾氣的反對很少能改好草稿。

members.speakLineEn: An affable chair kept the panel constructive.
members.speakLineZh: 和藹的主席讓座談保持建設性。

members.speakLineEn: His genial tone disarmed hostile reviewers.
members.speakLineZh: 他溫和的語氣化解了敵意審稿人。

members.speakLineEn: Amiable colleagues still need clear standards.
members.speakLineZh: 親切同事依然需要清楚標準。

members.speakLineEn: A cantankerous and venomous-tongued old lady.
members.speakLineZh: 脾氣差的。

members.speakLineEn: Consider this case: get testy in one’s old age.
members.speakLineZh: 易怒的，暴躁的。

members.speakLineEn: Picture the 春風臉: the word agreeable means 討人喜歡的.
members.speakLineZh: 想像「春風臉」：agreeable＝討人喜歡的。

members.speakLineEn: In the passage, good-natured signals a shift toward "脾氣好的".
members.speakLineZh: 文中 good-natured 標示語氣轉向「脾氣好的」。

members.speakLineEn: The critic noted her cranky approach to the evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 暴躁的。

members.speakLineEn: Picture the 熱茶: the word cordial means 熱誠的.
members.speakLineZh: 想像「熱茶」：cordial＝熱誠的。

quiz.promptZh: amiable（和善的人）常和哪個混淆？

clusters.titleZh: 節儉 ↔ 揮霍｜存錢筒對碎鈔機
clusters.hook: frugal／husband（勤儉）抱存錢筒，profligate／lavish 餵碎鈔機——會計在旁邊默默流淚。
clusters.script: 節儉隊：frugal／thrifty／provident／sparing／husband。揮霍隊：profligate／lavish／extravagant／spendthrift。口令：存錢筒寫「能省則省」，碎鈔機寫「今夜不回家」。

members.speakLineEn: A careful reader links frugal to 節儉的, not a lookalike neighbor.
members.speakLineZh: 細心讀者把 frugal 連到「節儉的」，不連形近鄰居。

members.speakLineEn: On the exam, thrifty most nearly means a sense of "節約的".
members.speakLineZh: 節約的。

members.speakLineEn: Sparing in their use of heat and light.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：吝惜使用的。

members.speakLineEn: On the exam, economical most nearly means a sense of "節省的".
members.speakLineZh: 節省的。

members.speakLineEn: In that case, they had to husband precious resources.
members.speakLineZh: 勤儉持家。

members.speakLineEn: Consider this case: lead a profligate life.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：揮霍的。

members.speakLineEn: On the exam, lavish most nearly means a sense of "奢華的".
members.speakLineZh: 奢華的。

members.speakLineEn: No one wanted to be labeled a spendthrift in that debate.
members.speakLineZh: 揮霍無度的。

members.speakLineEn: On the exam, wasteful most nearly means a sense of "浪費的".
members.speakLineZh: 浪費的。

members.speakLineEn: The critic noted her improvident approach to the evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有遠見的；不節儉的。

members.speakLineEn: You squandered the opportunity to get and advanced degree.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：揮霍。

members.speakLineEn: In the end, they chose to dissipate what they had once defended.
members.speakLineZh: 浪費；驅散。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would piggybank basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會存錢筒基本保障。

members.speakLineEn: A careful reader links shredder to 碎紙機, not a lookalike neighbor.
members.speakLineZh: 細心讀者把 shredder 連到「碎紙機」，不連形近鄰居。

members.speakLineEn: A careful reader links ledger to 帳本, not a lookalike neighbor.
members.speakLineZh: 細心讀者把 ledger 連到「帳本」，不連形近鄰居。

members.speakLineEn: Hold the meaning steady: coupon means 折扣券.
members.speakLineZh: 記住考意：coupon＝折扣券。

members.speakLineEn: In the passage, goldcoin signals a shift toward "金幣".
members.speakLineZh: 文中 goldcoin 標示語氣轉向「金幣」。

members.speakLineEn: The president submitted the annual budget to Congress.
members.speakLineZh: 例句對齊：預算。

members.speakLineEn: Hold the meaning steady: splurge means 揮霍夜.
members.speakLineZh: 記住考意：splurge＝揮霍夜。

members.speakLineEn: In the passage, savings signals a shift toward "存款".
members.speakLineZh: 文中 savings 標示語氣轉向「存款」。

members.speakLineEn: Critics argued that the policy would voidcheck basic protections.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者主張該政策會廢支票基本保障。
